name: marked-text
title: Marked text
description: A passage with the query's words in medium weight and ink, so the reader sees why it matched.
use_for: Search results and passages shown for a query.
never: Red or highlighted fills for matches
Marking words in text that was not searched
body: Words of four letters or more in `query` are marked wherever they appear in `text`, ignoring case. Set the passage in the soft grey so the marked words in ink stand out. Each word carries its place as `--w` for a reveal that plays it in reading order.
